title: The Real Influencers
paragraphs: §Thankful for You

What's up to the squad at Thessalonica! It's me, Paul, along with my boys Silas and Timothy. We're sending this to all of you who are part of the crew of God the Father and our main man, Jesus Christ. Hope you're feeling the positive energy and peace from God.
§Convictions of Steel

Seriously, we're always gassing you up to God. We can't stop telling him how awesome you guys are. We're constantly remembering how you're crushing it with your faith, showing major love to everyone, and patiently waiting for our leader, Jesus, to come back. We know for a fact that God doesn't just like you; He's totally chosen you for His team. When we shared the good news with you, it wasn't just a bunch of talk. The Holy Spirit showed up and made you guys totally sure about it, giving you an amazing change in your beliefs.

You guys saw how we rolled when we were with you, and you decided to be just like us. And by copying us, you were really copying the ultimate boss, Jesus. Even though you got a lot of hate for believing, you were still super stoked because of the Holy Spirit. You took the bad with the good, and the good with the bad, and that's what's up.

Because of you, everyone in Macedonia and Achaia is hearing about Jesus. You guys are the real influencers. Your faith is making so much noise that we don't even have to say anything. People are telling us how you welcomed us and ditched your old fake gods to serve the one true God. They're blown away by how you're all waiting for His Son, Jesus, to show up—the one who saved us from the ultimate punishment.

title: We're Legit, Not Fakes
paragraphs: §Paul's Ministry

Hey, what's up, guys? So, you know our visit wasn't a total bust. We got roughed up pretty bad back in Philippi, you remember that, but we didn't let it stop us. We had God's back, so we showed up and dropped his message on you, no matter who was hating on us.

God put us through the wringer to make sure we were the real deal, that he could trust us with his message. So for real, when we talk to you, we're not trying to get likes or follows—we're all about that God approval. We passed his vibe check, so you know we're not feeding you lies or have some secret plan. We never tried to sweet-talk you; you guys know that. And God knows we weren't just trying to scam you.

We could have flexed on you because we're apostles of Christ, but we never acted like we were big shots. We weren't all distant and weird with you. We just hung out with you like you were one of us. We weren't talking down to you; we cared about you like a mom cares for her kids. We seriously loved you guys. We didn't just want to give you the message; we wanted to give you a piece of our hearts. And we totally did.

You guys remember how we were, right? We worked like crazy, staying up all night, so we wouldn't be a burden to you while we were telling you about God. You saw for yourselves that we were cool and respectful, and we were super real with you because you're our fellow believers. And God knows we weren't just mooching off you! You saw it all. We were like a dad to each of you, giving you fist bumps, hyping you up, and showing you how to live a lit life for God, who invited us into his kingdom, into this awesome life.

And now, looking back, we're just so thankful to God. Like, a huge thank you! When you heard God's message from us, you didn't just blow it off like it was some random dude's opinion. You took it seriously as God's actual word, which it is, and now God is doing his thing in you guys!

You know, you're basically twinning with the churches of God in Judea, the OG followers of Jesus. You got the same hate from your own people that they got from theirs. The same people who killed the Lord Jesus and the prophets and then kicked us out of town. They're on God's bad side and everyone else's, because they're trying to stop us from telling people how to be saved. They've basically made a career out of being haters, and they're pros at it. But God's had enough. He's about to shut it down.

Man, you have no idea how much we miss you guys. It hasn't even been that long, and we're not *really* separated because you're in our hearts, but we've been trying so hard to come see you. I, Paul, have tried a bunch of times, but Satan kept blocking me. But when our Lord Jesus comes back, who do you think we're going to be bragging about? It's you! You guys are our ultimate trophy!

title: We Miss You Guys, For Real
paragraphs: §Encouraged by Your Faith

Hey, so we just couldn't take being away from you any longer. We were stuck in Athens and totally bummed we couldn't come see you. So, we sent our boy Timothy to check in, give you a boost, and make sure you weren't letting all the drama get you down. He's a solid guy, a real one in the faith, and he's all about spreading the good news about Jesus.

Honestly, you shouldn't be shocked that things are tough. We told you this was coming. It's just part of the deal. When we were with you, we gave you the heads-up that trouble was on the way. Now that it's here, you get it. That's why I was so worried. I had to know how you were holding up. I didn't want the devil to sneak in and mess everything up that we'd built together.

But then Timothy came back with a killer report about your faith and how you're all showing love to each other, and man, we felt so much better. It's awesome to hear that you guys still think we're cool and that you want to see us as much as we want to see you. Even though we're going through it over here, just knowing you're all good keeps us going. Your faith is giving us life.
Seriously, how can we even thank God enough for all the joy you guys bring us? We're praying for you 24/7, hoping we get to see you again soon and help you out if your faith ever gets a little shaky.

We're asking God and Jesus to make a path for us to get to you. And we're praying that you get an incredible renewal in the love department, so much that it spills over onto everyone around you, just like our love for you. We hope you're feeling strong, pure, and totally confident when Jesus comes back with his whole crew.

title: Level Up Your Life & The Ultimate Comeback
paragraphs: §Live to Please God

Alright, real talk, my guys. We’re not just gonna say this, we’re gonna shout it: keep crushing it for God. This isn’t some boring homework assignment; it’s like a victory dance. You already know the playbook we got from the head coach, Jesus. God’s main thing is for you to live clean. Stay away from all the sus stuff, you know?
Basically, have some self-respect. Your body is a temple, not a trash can, so don't treat it like people who don't even know God.
§God Called You to Be Holy

Don't be mean to your friends and family or step on them to get ahead. God sees that, and trust me, He'll handle it. We've told you before, God didn't call us to be messy and horrible. He's calling us to a powerful shift, inside and out.

And if you just ghost this advice, you’re not just dissing us, you’re straight-up rejecting God. And He’s the one giving you His Holy Spirit, which is honestly the best gift ever. So yeah, don't do that.

When it comes to being a good friend and getting along, you guys don’t even need me to lecture you. God already taught you how to be bros. Seriously, you’re already nailing it—we hear about how you’re treating everyone in Macedonia. So just keep getting better at it. Level up that friendship game.

And hey, chill out. Stop worrying about everyone else’s business and just focus on your own grind. We’ve said this a bunch, but it’s a good reminder. We want you to live in a way that even people outside our crew respect you, not just mooching off your friends all the time.
§The Master's Coming

Now, about the question you guys had about what happens to our friends who have already died. Don’t panic out about it like people who have no hope. The grave isn’t the end of the game. Since Jesus literally died and then rose again, God’s totally going to bring back everyone who was on Team Jesus when they died.

And get this—this is straight from the Master, so it’s legit. When Jesus comes back to get us, those of us who are still around won’t get to cut the line. The ones who already died? The dead who believed in Christ are the ones who go first. The Master Himself will give the signal—it’ll be like an archangel’s thunder and a massive trumpet blast. He’ll come down from heaven, and the dead who believed in Christ will rise up first. Then, the rest of us still here will get beamed up into the clouds with them to meet the Master. We’ll literally be walking on air! It’s gonna be one epic family reunion with Jesus. So, when you’re feeling down, just remember that and cheer each other up.

title: The Ultimate Surprise Party
paragraphs: §The Day of the Lord

Hey, what's up, guys? So, about when all this crazy end-of-the-world stuff is gonna go down... honestly, I don't even need to get into it. You already know the deal. The Master's return isn't something you can just mark on your calendar. He's not gonna send you a message with a heads-up. It's gonna be more like a thief in the night — totally random. Just when everyone's chilling, thinking, "We're so set, life is good," BAM! Everything goes sideways. It'll hit as suddenly and inescapably as labor pains hitting a pregnant woman.

But you guys are in the loop, so you won't be caught off guard. You're the real deal, the kids of the light. We're living in the open, we know what's up. So, let's not be like those other people, sleepwalking through life. Let's stay woke and be smart. They're the ones who are all about late-night partying and getting ruined. That's not our scene. We're all about the daylight, so let's act like it. Let's be clear-headed, rocking our faith, love, and the hope that we're saved.

God didn't choose us to face his anger; He chose us for a life-changing moment through our main man, Jesus. He took one for the team, and his death was the ultimate victory for us. So, whether we're alive and kicking or six feet under, we're alive *with him*! So, keep hyping each other up. Build that hope so everyone's on the same page, no one gets left behind. I know you're already doing it, so just keep that good energy flowing.
§The Way He Wants You to Live
Alright, now for the leaders who are putting in the work for you, the ones who are basically your spiritual coaches. You gotta show them some major respect. Shower them with appreciation and love!

And for everyone else, just get along. Do your part. If you see someone slacking, give them a friendly nudge to get back in the game. Be gentle with the ones who are struggling, and help out the ones who are totally wiped. Be patient with everyone, and pay attention to what they need. And when you start getting on each other's nerves, don't just start throwing shade. Look for the good in people and try to bring it out.
Always be stoked, no matter what. Keep the prayers coming, 24/7. And be thankful for everything, even the bad stuff. This is how God wants His squad, the followers of Jesus, to live.

Don't ignore the Holy Spirit, and don't shut down people who have a message from the big guy. But also, don't be a sucker. Check everything out, and only keep the good stuff. If something seems suspicious, toss it.

May God, the one who makes everything awesome, give you a complete renewal—spirit, soul, and body—and keep you ready for when our Master, Jesus, shows up. The one who called you is the real deal. If he said it, he'll do it. Seriously.
Keep praying for us, fam. Give all the other believers a big hug. And make sure everyone hears this message. Don't leave anyone out.
The amazing grace of Jesus Christ be with you all!
